records.name: Dragon Thunder
records.skill_description: Omega Shenron extends the spikes on his back to impale the opponent, producing a short-range multi-hit Strike attack that can only connect against an opponent positioned above him.
records.mechanics_notes: The Xenoverse 2 skill reference lists Dragon Thunder as a 16-hit, launching, short-range Strike Super. The move is tied to Omega Shenron's back spikes and has an anti-air positional restriction. It is also categorized as a Counter Skill, but no separate duplicate identity is created for that taxonomy.
records.acquisition_notes: The skill reference lists Unlock as N/A and identifies it as unavailable for CaC. Independent Dragon Ball documentation confirms that Dragon Thunder returns as an Omega Shenron Super Skill in Xenoverse 2 and cannot be obtained by the Future Warrior.
records.pve_notes: Cast-exclusive Omega Shenron skill; no Future Warrior acquisition route or Ultimate Finish condition established.
records.pvp_notes: Anti-air, short-range, multi-hit Strike attack with cast-specific usage; detailed frame and matchup behavior remains version-sensitive.
